properties.displayName: MAS - Manual attestation for Implement Just in time Access for RBAC with Azure PIM
properties.description: Manual attestation is required to validate Enforce the principle of least privilege and Just-In-Time access to restrict authorized access, with continuous monitoring, logging of privileged access and periodic reviews. (IAM-33).

metadata.Description:
Just-In-Time Access
for more details - refer to Control statement
Just-In-Time Access
- Developers request elevated access to production environments through a self-service portal
- Requests are automatically approved or routed for manual approval based on predefined policies
- Approved access is granted for a limited time period, typically 2-4 hours
metadata.controlTitle: Enforce the principle of least privilege and Just-In-Time access to restrict authorized access, with continuous monitoring, logging of privileged access and periodic reviews.

metadata.description: Enable or disable the execution of the policy
